description: Question-to-passage relevance judgments for the two assessment bids. Every judgment was written after reading the parsed source text and is verified against parsed pages and active chunk artifacts by scripts/evaluate_retrieval.py verify. Grades: 2 = passage directly answers, 1 = partial or supporting evidence. These labels are evaluation fixtures only and are never read by retrieval code.
needs_human_labeling: Bid1 main RFP page 35 target quantities: the prose and table extractions of the price schedule disagree (e.g. Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop 10,000 vs 5,000). No quantity question beyond line 15.01 was labeled until a human confirms against the PDF.
Bid1 main RFP pages 54-59 (IRS Form W-9, OCR without table structure): no questions labeled; OCR text quality was not human-verified.

Bid2 PORFP page 1 prose places '06/10/2024' before the 'PORFP Issue Date' label; the table extraction pairs PROPOSAL DUE with 06/10/2024. The proposal-due judgment relies on the table/HTML reading and should be confirmed visually.
Unanswerable natural-language cases (b1-unanswerable-bid-bond, b2-unanswerable-liquidated-damages) were checked by text search only; a human should confirm the documents truly contain no answer.

cases.notes: The identifier is in every page header; judgments cover the title page, BidNet listing and both addenda.
